name: Loox
summary: Shopify app that collects photo and video reviews with review request emails and shows them in on brand widgets, with AI sorting on paid plans.
best_for: Shopify stores that want to collect photo reviews after fulfilment and show them in on brand widgets
skip_if: you want video reviews or AI features without a paid plan, or you need to see real review requests working before you commit
honest_knock: The free plan keeps the Loox branding and leaves out video reviews and the AI features. The Convert trial asks for a payment method and its approval screen carried no test charge note. We could not send a review request or see a review, because our test store is password protected. The plan screen and the listing give two different limits for the free plan, 2,000 requests and 500 orders.

sessions.what: Our AI assistant ran the test on 19 November 2026 on a Shopify development store, with the interface in English. We installed Loox on the free Beginner plan, placed the review widget in the product template and set the review request timing. We did not approve the Convert trial, sent no emails and imported no reviews.
findings: Install: the permission screen lists customer data (sensitive data, device and activity data), staff data and store data such as customers, products, orders, discounts, marketing and the Online Store. The app opened on the free Beginner plan with no payment screen.

Setup: Loox activated its core script and added a Reviews Widget block to the default product template. The first review request was set to 14 days after fulfilment, with a 15% code for photo or video reviews by default.
Upsells: two pop ups pushed the Convert plan, one with a 14 day trial and one with 80% off for two months. We kept Beginner both times.
Convert trial: the Shopify approval screen showed $49.99 due on 3 December after a 14 day trial and needed a payment method. It carried no note that it was a test charge, so we did not approve it.
Plan limits: the plan screen said review requests sent 0 of 2,000 for Beginner, while the listing says up to 500 orders. Those are two different limits.
Result: our test store is password protected, and Loox only sends review requests for stores without a password. We saw no review and the widget showed nothing in the preview.
